Rockium Z: Once per battle for the team, turns a Rock attack into Continental Crush (power depends on the move), or adds a Rock status move's Z bonus. Deals 1/4 damage through Protect. Not used up.
Rocky Helmet: Each contact hit costs the attacker 1/6 of its own max HP. Triggers on every hit of a multi-hit move; Magic Guard prevents the damage.
Room Service: When Trick Room is active, lowers the holder's Speed by 1 stage. Used up.
Roseli Berry: Halves the damage of one super-effective Fairy hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Rowap Berry: After surviving a special hit, the attacker loses 1/8 of its own max HP. Eaten once; does not require contact.
Rusted Shield: Zamazenta becomes Crowned Shield, gaining Steel typing and turning Iron Head into Behemoth Bash.
Rusted Sword: Zacian becomes Crowned Sword, gaining Steel typing and turning Iron Head into Behemoth Blade.
Safety Goggles: Blocks powder moves, Effect Spore and weather damage from sandstorm and hail.
Salac Berry: At 1/4 max HP or less, raises Speed by 1 stage. Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.
Scope Lens: Raises the holder's critical-hit rate by 1 stage.
Shed Shell: Lets the holder switch out despite trapping moves or abilities. Does not let it flee from wild battles.
Shell Bell: After a damaging move, restores 1/8 of the total damage dealt, including all hits and targets. Does not trigger on a Sheer Force-boosted move.
Shock Drive: Makes Genesect's Techno Blast Electric type.
Shuca Berry: Halves the damage of one super-effective Ground hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Sitrus Berry: Eaten when the holder drops to 1/2 HP or less: restores 1/4 of its max HP. Once.
Sky Plate: Flying moves do 1.2× damage. With Multitype, also makes Arceus and Judgment Flying type.
Smoke Ball: Lets the holder flee from wild battles, even through trapping. Does not let it switch out of trapping.

Smooth Rock.gen<=5: Sandstorm used by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Smooth Rock: Sandstorm started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.

Snorlium Z: Once per battle for the team, Snorlax's Giga Impact becomes Pulverizing Pancake: 210-power Normal damage. Not used up.
Snowball: After surviving an Ice hit, raises Attack by 1 stage. Used up.
Solganium Z: Once per battle for the team, Solgaleo or Dusk Mane Necrozma's Sunsteel Strike becomes Searing Sunraze Smash: 200-power Steel damage that ignores abilities. Not used up.

Soul Dew.gen<=6: Latias's and Latios's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def are ×1.5.
Soul Dew: Latias's and Latios's Dragon and Psychic moves do 1.2× damage.

Splash Plate: Water moves do 1.2× damage. With Multitype, also makes Arceus and Judgment Water type.
Spooky Plate: Ghost moves do 1.2× damage. With Multitype, also makes Arceus and Judgment Ghost type.
Starf Berry: At 1/4 max HP or less, raises a random stat by 2 stages, excluding accuracy and evasion. Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.

Steel Gem.gen<=5: The first successful damaging Steel move does 1.5× damage; the gem is used up. Boosts every hit of a multi-hit move.
Steel Gem: The first damaging Steel move does 1.3× damage; the gem is used up.

Steel Memory: With RKS System, makes Silvally and Multi-Attack Steel type. Does not boost damage.
Steelium Z: Once per battle for the team, turns a Steel attack into Corkscrew Crash (power depends on the move), or adds a Steel status move's Z bonus. Deals 1/4 damage through Protect. Not used up.
Stick: Raises Farfetch'd's critical-hit rate by 2 stages.
Sticky Barb: At each turn's end, the holder loses 1/8 max HP. Transfers to an attacker with no held item when it lands a contact move.
Stone Plate: Rock moves do 1.2× damage. With Multitype, also makes Arceus and Judgment Rock type.
Tanga Berry: Halves the damage of one super-effective Bug hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Tapunium Z: Once per battle for the team, a Tapu's Nature's Madness becomes Guardian of Alola: removes 3/4 of the target's current HP. Not used up.
Terrain Extender: Terrain started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Thick Club: Doubles Cubone's and Marowak's Attack, including Alolan Marowak.
Throat Spray: After the holder successfully uses a sound move, raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Used up; works with sound-based status moves too.
Timer Ball: Catch rate starts at ×1 and gains about ×0.3 per completed turn, up to ×4 after 10 turns.
Toxic Orb: Badly poisons the holder at each turn's end if it has no status and can be poisoned. Poison Heal restores 1/8 max HP each turn instead of poison damage. Not used up.
Toxic Plate: Poison moves do 1.2× damage. With Multitype, also makes Arceus and Judgment Poison type.
Ultranecrozium Z: Lets Dusk Mane or Dawn Wings Necrozma Ultra Burst. Once per battle for the team, Ultra Necrozma turns Photon Geyser into Light That Burns the Sky: 200 power, using its higher attacking stat; ignores abilities. Not used up.
Utility Umbrella: Rain and sun do not modify damage or accuracy of incoming moves. The holder's own attacks still use the weather; blocks weather healing or damage from abilities such as Dry Skin.
Wacan Berry: Halves the damage of one super-effective Electric hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.

Water Gem.gen<=5: The first successful damaging Water move does 1.5× damage; the gem is used up. Boosts every hit of a multi-hit move.
Water Gem: The first damaging Water move does 1.3× damage; the gem is used up.

Water Memory: With RKS System, makes Silvally and Multi-Attack Water type. Does not boost damage.
Waterium Z: Once per battle for the team, turns a Water attack into Hydro Vortex (power depends on the move), or adds a Water status move's Z bonus. Deals 1/4 damage through Protect. Not used up.
Weakness Policy: After surviving a super-effective hit, raises Attack and Sp. Atk by 2 stages each. Used up; can activate between hits of a multi-hit move.
Wellspring Mask: Ogerpon becomes its Wellspring form with Water Absorb; all its moves do 1.2× damage.
White Herb: Restores all negative stat stages to 0, then is used up. Keeps positive stages; clears both Defense drops from Shell Smash at once.

Wiki Berry.gen<=6: At 1/2 max HP or less, restores 1/8 max HP. Confuses a holder whose nature lowers Sp. Atk. Eaten once.
Wiki Berry.gen<=7: At 1/4 max HP or less, restores 1/2 max HP. Confuses a holder whose nature lowers Sp. Atk; Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.
Wiki Berry: At 1/4 max HP or less, restores 1/3 max HP. Confuses a holder whose nature lowers Sp. Atk; Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.

X Accuracy.gen<=6: Raises the active Pokémon's accuracy by 1 stage. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.
X Accuracy: Raises the active Pokémon's accuracy by 2 stages. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.

X Attack.gen<=6: Raises the active Pokémon's Attack by 1 stage. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.
X Attack: Raises the active Pokémon's Attack by 2 stages. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.

X Defense.gen<=6: Raises the active Pokémon's Defense by 1 stage. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.
X Defense: Raises the active Pokémon's Defense by 2 stages. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.

X Sp. Atk.gen<=6: Raises the active Pokémon's Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.
X Sp. Atk: Raises the active Pokémon's Sp. Atk by 2 stages. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.

X Sp. Def.gen<=6: Raises the active Pokémon's Sp. Def by 1 stage. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.
X Sp. Def: Raises the active Pokémon's Sp. Def by 2 stages. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.

X Speed.gen<=6: Raises the active Pokémon's Speed by 1 stage. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.
X Speed: Raises the active Pokémon's Speed by 2 stages. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.

Yache Berry: Halves the damage of one super-effective Ice hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Zap Plate: Electric moves do 1.2× damage. With Multitype, also makes Arceus and Judgment Electric type.
Zoom Lens: The holder's moves have 1.2× accuracy when the target has already acted this turn.
